title: Computer Hardware Engineer
description:
Job DescriptionComputer Hardware Engineer / Desktop Support Engineer

**Job Title:** Computer Hardware Engineer / Desktop Support Engineer  
**Department:** IT / Technical Support  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Reports To:** IT Manager / IT Head

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and customer-focused **Computer Hardware Engineer / Desktop Support Engineer** to provide technical support, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, maintain IT infrastructure, and ensure smooth operation of computers, peripherals, and network-connected devices.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot **desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals**.
* Diagnose and repair hardware problems involving **RAM, hard drives/SSDs, motherboards, power supplies, monitors, keyboards, mice, and other components**.
* Install and configure **Windows operating systems, drivers, applications, and security software**.
* Provide first-level and second-level **desktop and technical support** to employees.
* Troubleshoot issues related to **Windows, Microsoft Office, email, printers, internet connectivity, and system performance**.
* Perform computer formatting, OS installation, system upgrades, data backup, and hardware replacement.
* Troubleshoot basic **LAN, Wi-Fi, IP configuration, DNS, DHCP, and network connectivity** issues.
* Configure and maintain printers, scanners, UPS systems, and other office equipment.
* Maintain an updated **IT asset inventory** and record hardware allocation, repairs, replacements, and warranties.
* Monitor system health and perform regular preventive maintenance.
* Install and update antivirus, security patches, drivers, and required software.
* Coordinate with external vendors for hardware repairs, AMC services, and warranty claims.
* Maintain proper documentation of support tickets and technical issues.
* Ensure IT systems comply with company security and data-protection policies.
* Provide remote and on-site technical support whenever required.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **computer hardware and troubleshooting**.
* Strong knowledge of **Windows 10/11 and Microsoft Office**.
* Basic knowledge of **LAN, Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP**.
* Knowledge of computer assembly, installation, and hardware upgrades.
* Ability to troubleshoot printers and other peripherals.
* Basic understanding of antivirus and endpoint security.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple support requests.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field**.
* Certifications such as **A+, Network+, MCITP, or equivalent** will be an advantage.

Experience

* **1–3 years** of experience in desktop support, hardware troubleshooting, IT support, or a similar role.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge and practical hardware experience may also be considered.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* Timely resolution of hardware and software support tickets.
* System uptime and availability.
* Reduction in recurring technical issues.
* Accurate IT asset and inventory records.
* Preventive maintenance completion.
* User satisfaction with IT support.

Personal Attributes

* Responsible and dependable.
* Quick learner with a problem-solving attitude.
* Patient and service-oriented.
* Good communication skills.
* Willingness to travel between company locations when required.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet support deadlines.

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Allica Bank**

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

**Role Description**

As a Data Engineer / BI Analyst at Kriya, you'll own the flow of data from our source systems through to the reports and insights the business relies on every day. You'll build and maintain the pipelines that bring data together, model it in Power BI so teams can self-serve, and work directly with stakeholders to turn business questions into datasets and reports they can trust.

This is a broad, hands-on role spanning both data engineering and BI, with a high degree of autonomy. You'll also own key recurring data processes end-to-end and the tooling behind them (Power BI, Synapse Analytics). The role includes building Power BI semantic models and reports, but it is not primarily a business-insights or analyst position. Success means reliable pipelines, trustworthy curated data, maintainable semantic models, safe releases, and effective production support. Insights and analytics are a plus.

A key part of the role is making data accessible through AI, enabling business users to ask questions of our data in natural language, so trusted answers aren't gated behind a report request or a SQL query.

**Principal Accountabilities**

* **Deliver trusted, analysis-ready data**. Own the data flow from source systems to the reports the business relies on, so decisions are made on data people can trust.
* **Keep the data platform running**. Keep extraction, transformation, feeds and scheduled reports flowing reliably - "keep the lights on" for data.
* **Support data-driven decisions** with BI models, reports, and dashboards.
* **Enable business users to self-serve** through training and knowledge sharing. Make data available via AI **so users can ask questions about data in natural language**.

**Detailed:**

* **Data engineering**: design, implement, and optimise data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL/ELT) data from multiple sources, ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.
* **Data quality and integrity**: implement best practices for data validation, cleansing, and governance to guarantee high-quality, consistent, and reliable datasets.
* **Data delivery:** work directly with business stakeholders to scope and build bespoke datasets and reports supporting business decisions. Maintain data dictionaries, pipelines and delivery methods (SFTP feeds, Google Sheets integrations, etc).
* **Data modelling (BI)**: Design and maintain the semantic layer in Power BI so business users can self-serve reliably. Ensure models are well-documented and consistent.
* **Process ownership**: Own end-to-end recurring data processes, like CAIS, DCM, data tapes. You will be working directly with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Tool ownership**: Own the data tooling end-to-end (Power BI, Synapse Analytics): configuration, security, access, maintenance, upgrades and user enablement/training.
* **Maintenance**: ensure observability, resolve problems, alerts, incidents and BAU requests

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* Fluent in English
* Ability to work UK working hours
* 5+ years of experience as DE/BI
* solid SQL, Azure Synapse (or Azure Data Factory), PowerBI skills
* Python, Google Cloud Platform, Looker are nice to have
* Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) where audit trails and data accuracy have compliance implications and some reports are deadline-sensitive.

**Working at Allica Bank**

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

**Flexible working**

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

**Diversity**

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Lead Engineer - Passkeys
description:
Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" – we continue to offer a full\-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise\-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.



As a Lead Engineer for our Passkeys team, you will be responsible for leading the technical direction and supporting the engineering effort of a team focused on building and maintaining Bitwarden's WebAuthn credential provider implementation across browser, desktop, and mobile. The Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 \- creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.



You will be expected to own and understand the entirety of the team's domain, and be able to support the other engineers on the team as well as engage in well\-reasoned discussions with other technical leaders in the organization.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO**


* Design, build, and maintain Bitwarden's implementation of the WebAuthn and FIDO2 standards in Rust, including credential creation, assertion, and storage within an end\-to\-end encrypted vault
* Integrate our passkey implementation with each platform's credential provider surface across browser, desktop, and mobile clients
* Participate in the hands\-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across all Bitwarden clients
* Implement and help shape emerging standards for credential portability and secure import and export between providers
* Build the interoperability testing that keeps our implementation correct against the long tail of relying parties, browsers, and platforms our users encounter in the real world
* Work closely with your manager to maintain the technical roadmap for the team, ensuring that core platform dependencies are up to date and emerging technologies are considered for potential adoption.
* Unblock and support other engineers on the team.
* Collaborate with other Tech Leads to ensure that cross\-team technical direction is aligned when initiatives span team boundaries.
* Serve as a representative of the team in technical discussions and be able to speak authoritatively about your domain.
* Set the example for thorough code reviews, using them to spread knowledge on the team and ensure high standards for code quality.
* Occasionally review \& approve bug fixes submitted by the user community


**WHAT YOU BRING**


* 8\+ years of experience as lead or team lead. Experience designing and implementing complex user interaction flows in Angular applications and native OS (Windows, MacOS, Linux), including developing against native OS APIs.
* Expertise in developing and maintaining production Rust components, including the design and application of libraries, language bindings, and FFI.
* Experience implementing a standard or protocol from its specification, and the discipline that requires \- reading the spec closely, handling the edge cases, and testing against real\-world implementations rather than assuming conformance.
* Working knowledge of applied cryptography \- you can reason about public key cryptography, signatures, and key handling, and you know where the sharp edges are
* A rigorous approach to correctness \- you write readable, testable code, and you think carefully about failure modes in software that handles sensitive data.
* A bias for long\-horizon thinking, ensuring that decisions made today build stable and maintainable tooling for the future.
* Experience on a Platform team, where other teams are your customers, and you are responsible for ensuring that their feature development can be done with tooling as a support and not a hindrance.
* Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
* Collaborative and adaptable mindset
* Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

### **Why Join Us**

description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high\-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre\-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.


The ideal candidate has strong distributed\-systems and API\-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.


This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre\-approved benign scenarios.  



  

**Project Details**  

  

**Title:** Senior SDET  

**Rate:** $13\.5/hr
  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 5 Weeks  

**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record\-linking
* Execute pre\-approved request variations and boundary\-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data\-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near\-real\-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer\-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post\-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed\-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure\-mode and chaos\-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5\-8\+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter\-service API behavior
* Hands\-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root\-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence\-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Research Engineer
description:
**About Atlys**


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**


We're looking for a **Research Engineer, AI** to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.


You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.


This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.

**The Job**

* **Build AI systems that do real work** by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* **Push the frontier of document intelligence** by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* **Define how we measure AI quality** by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* **Run experiments that change decisions** by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* **Own systems end to end** by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.

**The Ideal Candidate**


You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.

**What you can expect**


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

**Here's what you can expect:**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

OPEXEngine, a Bain \& Company solution, is a proprietary B2B SaaS benchmarking database covering 1,200\+ participating SaaS companies, 250\+ metrics, and 130,000\+ validated data points.
